summary: Backend-only verification of Binance USD-M Futures fapi1-4 fallback fix. Ran the 6 targeted mocked pytest files (29 tests) — all passed. Verified GET /api/futures/diagnose returns 200 with base=https://fapi1.binance.com (new default, not fapi.binance.com). Verified /api/bot/config accepts exchange=binance_futures, futuresLeverage, futuresTestnet; /api/bot/status returns futuresBase & futuresMode; setting futuresTestnet=true switches base to https://testnet.binancefuture.com and false reverts to fapi1.binance.com.

minor.issue: openPositions call raises TypeError "'str' object has no attribute 'get'" from _fapi_positions line 381 — rows likely came back as list of strings (or signed response wasn't the expected list of dicts). Endpoint still returns HTTP 200 (handled in try/except), but the error is surfaced in the 'error' field. Note: from this preview server fapi1 is actually reachable (HTTP 302 on /ping) — not fully geo-blocked as expected, so positionMode='one-way' was returned successfully; the error is in a downstream call, not the fallback logic.

action_items: Investigate _fapi_positions parsing: `[x for x in rows if float(x.get('positionAmt', 0)...` fails when `rows` isn't a list of dicts. Likely fapi_signed returned a top-level dict (error payload) or a list of strings. Add a guard: if not isinstance(rows, list) or (rows and not isinstance(rows[0], dict)): return []. This is a minor pre-existing surface error in diagnose output, unrelated to the geo-fallback fix itself.
critical_code_review_comments: fapi_signed fallback skip condition should probably include network timeouts/connect errors too (currently only 403/451 — ok per spec).
server.py is 2137 lines — above 700-line guideline; consider modularizing (futures/, hyperliquid/, bot/ submodules).

success_rate.backend: 100% (29/29 mocked tests + 3/3 API checks; 1 minor diagnose downstream error unrelated to fallback)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Fapi1-4 fallback fix verified. Preview server CAN reach fapi1.binance.com (HTTP 302) — it is NOT fully geo-blocked as the task description assumed; only fapi.binance.com returned 451. Diagnose endpoint has a secondary bug in _fapi_positions ('str' object has no attribute 'get') — low priority. Default base, testnet toggle, config/status endpoints all behave correctly.
